thread:
anya: Quick design sync on API key presets + empty states. Pushing a compact mock to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/klmn123 (frames attached)
tom: Nice cleanup. Main ask: surface permission presets as chips (Read vectors, Service (gen+chat), Admin) with one-line helper under each. Users can expand to granular toggles if they need.
mike: Agree. Also add a subtle billing warning when a preset enables generation: 'Allows model generation — may incur costs'. Keep tone neutral.
sophia: Accessibility notes: 1) 'Show secret' must be a labeled button (aria-pressed) not an icon-only toggle, 2) when the secret is revealed move focus to the copy button and announce via a live region 'Secret displayed. Copy now.'
a11y-bot: Automated scan : warning pill contrast is 3.6:1 on current palette. Recommendation: darken text to #332100 or adjust bg to hit 4.5:1. Also ensure focus targets meet 48x48 on touch.
tom: For rotation flow, prefer 'Rotate key' label. After rotate show a 48h grace banner: 'Both keys active for 48 hours. Test the new key, then revoke the old.' Include small 'Test new key' CTA that runs a sample curl and shows status inline.
mike: The test runner should show status code, latency, and a short snippet of the body. Provide a single-line curl ready to copy: curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' https://api.redwood.com/v1/health. Add a copy button.
sophia: Empty-state copy for keys list: replace 'No keys' with 'No API keys yet — create a key to start calling the API or connect an OAuth app. Need least privilege? See key scopes.' Keep the docs link subtle.
tom: Bulk revoke UX: for >5 keys require typing REVOKE to confirm; for 1-4 keys show a toast with 30s undo. Balances safety and speed.
mike: Mobile: collapse table rows into stacked cards, hide last-used column and show it in subtitle, actions in a kebab. Add a dense-mode toggle in settings for power users.
a11y-bot: Also check keyboard order: name -> preset picker -> expiration -> create. After copy, snackbar with role='status' should announce 'Secret copied'.
sophia: Copy nits: post-create toast should read 'API key created — copy the secret now. It won't be shown again.' Offer a 'Download .env' quick action.
tom: Small UI tweak: use sentence case for helper text and footers.
anya: I'll fold these into the PR description and tag @mike for the sample curl formatting and @sophia for a11y acceptance criteria. Thanks all!
